analysis_rules: Read all original solution.schedule fields; verify every plan SHA against INPUT_DOMAIN_SCREEN.json; do not select by old solver/execution outcomes.
Within each complete robot path, count nonzero directed unit MOVE edges; exact repeated start/end pairs are duplicates; consecutive WAIT excluded.
For passage order only, merge consecutive occupancy at the same grid vertex; for distinct robots, order two visits when earlier.end_t < later.start_t.
Record a robot pair with both passage orders when opposite directions occur at distinct visits. No new order is chosen. Discrete times are not stopped-primitive physical time.
No continuous safety, v2 qualification, roadmap runtime benefit or algorithm novelty follows from these input counts.

Opposite robot-level order does not imply an action/event dependency cycle or continuous infeasibility.
Global right-ray stopping results remain valid only in their stated subproblem scope.
